# Aerocomfort

> Aerocomfort installs, repairs, maintains and cleans air conditioning across the Costa Blanca and Costa Cálida, Spain — Torrevieja, Orihuela Costa, Guardamar, the Mar Menor, Mazarrón and 45+ towns. Also heat pumps (aerotermia) and ventilation. 5.0★ on Google (160+ reviews), 1000+ installations. Certified for fluorinated-gas handling; 3-year guarantee on installation plus a 3-year manufacturer warranty on equipment. English and Spanish spoken.

## Services
- Installation — new air-conditioning and multi-split units, sized and fitted cleanly: /services/installation
- Repair — fast diagnosis and fixes for units not cooling, leaking or noisy: /services/repair
- Maintenance — servicing to keep units efficient, healthy and under warranty: /services/maintenance
- Cleaning — deep cleaning for cleaner air and lower energy bills: /services/cleaning
- Also: heat pumps (aerotermia) and ventilation systems.
